questions.q_en: The base of a prism is a square of side 4.5 cm. If the lateral surface area of prism is 126 sq. cm, then the difference between the height of prism and side of square is:
questions.solution_en:
Side of square = 4.5 cm

Perimeter of square = 4 * 4.5 = 18 cm

Lateral surface area = 126

Base perimeter * height = 126

18 * height = 126

Height = 126/18

Height = 7 cm

Required difference = 7 - 4.5 = 2.5 cm

Required time = 195/5 = 39 sec

questions.q_en: A dishonest dealer professes to sell his goods at the cost price, but he uses a false weight of 750 grams per 1 kg weight. Find the percentage of his gain. (Correct up to two decimal places).
questions.solution_en:
Percentage gain = (True weight - False weight)/false weight * 100

True weight = 1000 grams

False weight = 750 grams

Percentage gain = (1000 - 750)/750 * 100 = 33.33%

questions.q_en: The perimeter of a triangle is 30 cm and its area is numerically equal to the sum of its sides. If one of the sides measures 12 cm, what is the length (in cm) of the largest side of the triangle?
questions.solution_en:
Let the largest side of the triangle be x cm.

Given, one of the sides = 12 cm.

∴ The remaining two sides are x cm and (18 - x) cm.

Given, area of the triangle = perimeter

=> √{15(15 - 12)(15 - x)(15 - 18 + x)} = 30 [According to Heron's formula]

=> 15 * 3 * (15 - x) (x - 3) = 30 * 30

=> (15 - x)(x - 3) = 20

=> 15x - 45 - x² + 3x = 20

=> x² - 18x + 65 = 0

=> (x - 13)(x - 5) = 0

=> x = 13 cm (largest side of the triangle).

questions.q_en: The downstream distance covered by boat B in 1 hour is 18km. If in still water the speeds of boat A and boat B is 30km/h and 12km/h respectively, then what is the total time taken by boat A to go 18 km in downstream and 8 km in upstream?
questions.solution_en:
Given that, the speed of boat B in still water = 12 km/h

Downstream speed of boat B = 18/1 = 18 km/h

Speed of stream = 18 - 12 = 6 km/h

Required time taken = [18/(30 + 6)] + [8/(30 - 6)] = 50 minutes

questions.q_en: On a 2200 m long circular track, Sarita and Kavita drove their cycles from the same point but in opposite direction with the speeds 20 km/hr and 16 km/hr, respectively. After how much time will they meet again for the first time?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed = 20 + 16 = 36 km/hr

= 36 X (1000 / 3600) = 10 m/s

Time to meet = circumference / relative speed = 2200 / 10 = 220 seconds

= 220 / 60 = 3 minutes + 40 seconds = 3 minutes 40 seconds

Option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: There is a pyramid on a base, which is a regular hexagon of side 16a. If every slant edge of this pyramid is of length 17a, then find the lateral surface area of this pyramid.
questions.solution_en:
Let the height of the pyramid be 'h.'

The side of an equilateral triangle = 16a

Salant edge (e) = 17a

Salant height = l

l = √[e2 - (side/2)2]

= √[289a2 - 64a2]

= 15a

The lateral surface area = 1/2 * perimeter of hexagon * slant height

= 1/2 * 6 * 16a * 15a

= 720a2

Speed of Y - speed of X

Relative speed = 3.75 - 2.5=1.25 m/sec

So they will meet again in :-

750/1.25=600 seconds.

questions.q_en: Naman bought few apples for ₹720 from a shop. He negotiated the price and the shopkeeper reduced it by ₹2 per apple. Due to this Naman could buy four more apples than what he had bought earlier. How many apples did he originally buy?
questions.solution_en:
Let the number of apples bought and cost per apple be x and Rs. P

After negotiation cost = (P - 2)

Number of apples = (x + 4)

According to question,

x * P = 720..........(i)

(P - 2)(x + 4) = 720......(ii)

P = 720/x

Putting value of P in eq(ii) we get,

[720/x - 2][x + 4] = 720

[(720 - 2x)/x](x+4) = 720

2x2 + 8x - 2880 = 0

x2 + 4x - 1440 = 0

x = 36

questions.q_en: The radius of two circles with centres X and Y are 12 cm and 6 cm, respectively. If a transverse common tangent MN to both the circles which cuts the line joining the both centres X and Y at point O such that MO = 16 cm, then what is the distance between both centres of the circles if M is point on bigger circle and N is point on smaller circle?
questions.solution_en:
MO = 16 cm

Since ∠XMO = ∠ONY = 90°

By Pythagoras theorem,

XO2 = XM2 + MO2

=> XO2 = 122 + 162

=> XO2 = 144 + 256 = 400

=> XO = 20 cm

Since ∠XMO = ∠ONY = 90°

And ∠MOX = ∠YON (transverse angle)

So, ∠MXO = ∠OYN

Hence, ∆XMO and ∆OYN are similar triangles.

XM/YN = XO/YO

=> 12/6 = 20/YO

=> YO = 20/2 = 10 cm

Hence, XY = XO + OY = 20 + 10 = 30 cm

questions.q_en: A circular garden of radius 'R' has a drain of 7m around it. If the area of drain around the garden is 462m2 then find the value of R (in m).
questions.solution_en:
Radius of the circular garden = R

Radius of the circular garden with drain = R + 7

(Area of circular garden with drain) - (Area of circular garden) = 462 m2

Π(R+7)2 - πR2 = 462

22/7 * (R2 + 49 + 14R - R2) = 462

14R + 49 = 21 * 7

2R + 7 = 21

2R = 14

R = 7m
